description: This file contains initialization and helper functions for Gitweb tests, including setting up configurations, running test scripts, and performing environmental checks for prerequisites like Perl modules. It sources other scripts for auxiliary functions.

methods.name: gitweb_init
methods.description: Initializes Gitweb testing environment, creates configuration files, and sets the script name for testing.

methods.name: gitweb_run
methods.description: Simulates running gitweb with specified query parameters, capturing output and headers.
